newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 15.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Three former executives of Nomura Securities Co Ltd arrested in payoff scandal.
-- Fiscal reform panel seeks cut in pension payment.
-- Okinawa Prefecture to mark 25th anniversary of reversion to Japan.
-- Finance Ministry to ban licensing system for brokerage houses, switch to registration system.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) administrative reform panel recommends fiscal reform for local governments.
